changes: First Modwerk catalog release of Sam Banks’s MIDI mapping patch: CC68–73 control the six FX1 SETUP parameters.
Retain the upstream implementation and real UI captures; verify stock bytes from the user’s own local firmware.

USB package (14 Oct 2026; distribution only, the module source and version are unchanged): loads over USB on the Modwerk beta base. It is linked for that base’s sample arena and module pool, so it needs that exact base; with an older base the site asks for a base update first. Its compiled bytes that coincide with stock are copied at install from bytes the base checks against its running stock, so the package carries no stock bytes. Host tests only; no hardware run of this package. The owner waived hardware evidence for this exact version’s USB package for the beta.
